newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Leading Swedish business figure Svanholm dies.
newsitem.headline: Leading Swedish business figure Svanholm dies.

text.p: A top Swedish business leader, Bert-Olof Svanholm, died on Tuesday, at the age of 62.
Svanholm had been chairman of vehicle maker AB Volvo since 1994 and chairman of the Confederation of Swedish Industries since 1995.
Replacements to his positions have yet to be announced.
Svanholm had been ill for some time and had already decided to stand down as chairman of the confederation at its annual meeting on April 16.

In recent weeks Svanholm headed a group of 102 business leaders in a battle against the current government, saying its economic policies and agreement to phase out Sweden's nuclear power industry was not supporting the business community.
